SELECT
    p.growalias AS plant_name,
    p.gencapmw AS capacity_mw,
    m.maintcostusd AS total_maintenance_costs,
    m.revlossusd AS revenue_losses,
    (m.maintcostusd / m.revlossusd) AS maintenance_cost_efficiency_score,
    (m.revlossusd / p.gencapmw) AS revenue_loss_rate,
    (jsonb_extract_path(perf.efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'curreffpct')::numeric) AS current_efficiency_percentage,
    (jsonb_extract_path(perf.efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'efflosspct')::numeric) AS efficiency_loss_percentage
FROM 
    plant p
JOIN 
    maintenance m ON p.growregistry = m.powerref
JOIN 
    performance perf ON m.obsref = perf.perfregistry
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.growalias AS site_name,
    pan.panemark AS panel_id,
    p.initdate AS start_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.initdate) AS service_years,
    eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS efficiency_values,
    eff.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate' AS annual_degradation_rate,
    eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'efflosspct' AS efficiency_loss_metric,
    -- Calculate NDI using the formula provided
    (
        (
            CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
            -
            (
                CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate' AS DECIMAL)
                *
                (
                    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.initdate)
                )
            )
        )
        / CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
    ) AS calculated_ndi,
    -- Categorize panels based on NDI
    CASE
        WHEN (
            (
                CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
                -
                (
                    CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate' AS DECIMAL)
                    *
                    (
                        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.initdate)
                    )
                )
            )
            / CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
        ) > 0.8 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (
            (
                CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
                -
                (
                    CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate' AS DECIMAL)
                    *
                    (
                        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.initdate)
                    )
                )
            )
            / CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
        ) BETWEEN 0.6 AND 0.8 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS panel_category
FROM
    plant p
JOIN
    panel pan ON p.growregistry = pan.hubregistry
JOIN
    performance eff ON pan.panemark = eff.solmodref;

SELECT
    p.growalias AS site_name,
    pl.panemark AS panel_id,
    p.initdate AS start_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.initdate) AS service_years,
    jsonb_extract_path(perf.efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'curreffpct')::NUMERIC AS efficiency_values,
    jsonb_extract_path(perf.efficiency_profile, 'degradation', 'anndegrate')::NUMERIC AS annual_degradation_rate,
    jsonb_extract_path(perf.efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'efflosspct')::NUMERIC AS efficiency_loss_metric,
    (jsonb_extract_path(perf.efficiency_profile, 'degradation', 'anndegrate')::NUMERIC / jsonb_extract_path(perf.efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'curreffpct')::NUMERIC) AS calculated_NDI,
    CASE
        WHEN jsonb_extract_path(perf.efficiency_profile, 'degradation', 'anndegrate')::NUMERIC > 0.5 THEN 'High Degradation'
        WHEN jsonb_extract_path(perf.efficiency_profile, 'degradation', 'anndegrate')::NUMERIC BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.5 THEN 'Moderate Degradation'
        ELSE 'Low Degradation'
    END AS panel_category
FROM
    plant p
JOIN
    panel pl ON p.growregistry = pl.hubregistry
JOIN
    performance perf ON pl.panemark = perf.solmodref;

SELECT
    p.panemark AS panel_id,
    p.tempcoef AS coefficient,
    p.nomtempc AS temperature,
    jsonb_extract_path(eff.efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'curreffpct') AS efficiency_metric,
    jsonb_extract_path(env.irradiance_conditions, 'irradiance_types', '3') AS plane_of_array_irradiance,
    -- Calculate the adjusted efficiency
    (jsonb_extract_path(eff.efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'curreffpct')::numeric -
    (p.tempcoef * (env.celltempc - p.nomtempc))) AS efficiency_result
FROM
    panel AS p
JOIN
    performance AS eff ON p.panemark = eff.solmodref
JOIN
    environment AS env ON p.hubregistry = env.arearegistry
LIMIT 10;

    p.paneeffpct AS efficiency_metric,
    e.irradiance_conditions->'irradiance_types' AS plane_of_array_irradiance,
    p.paneeffpct * (1 + p.tempcoef * (e.celltempc - p.nomtempc)) AS efficiency_result

SELECT

    p.powratew AS power_ratings,
    perf.measpoww AS current_power,
    (efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::DECIMAL AS degradation,
    env.soillosspct AS soiling_loss,
    (inverter.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::DECIMAL AS inverter_losses,
    (
        (p.powratew * (efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::DECIMAL / 100)
        + (perf.measpoww * env.soillosspct / 100)
        + (inverter.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::DECIMAL
    ) AS total_system_loss
FROM
    panel AS p
JOIN
    performance AS perf ON p.panemark = perf.solmodref
JOIN
    environment AS env ON p.hubregistry = env.arearegistry
JOIN
    inverter ON p.hubregistry = inverter.siteref
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    invertregistry AS inverter_unique_identifier,
    (power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::DECIMAL(7,3) AS quality_score,
    (power_metrics->>'harmdistpct')::DECIMAL(7,3) AS harmonic_distortion_percentage,
    (power_metrics->>'invertpowfac')::NUMERIC(7,3) AS power_factor,
    (
        (gridvolt * gridfreqhz) / (
            (power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::DECIMAL(7,3) * 
            (power_metrics->>'invertpowfac')::NUMERIC(7,3)
        )
    ) AS grid_quality
FROM 
    inverter;

SELECT 
    invertregistry AS inverter_unique_identifier,
    pwrqualidx AS quality_score,
    (power_metrics->>'harmdistpct')::NUMERIC AS harmonic_distortion_percentage,
    (power_metrics->>'invertpowfac')::NUMERIC AS power_factor,
    ROUND(
        pwrqualidx * (
            1 - ((power_metrics->>'harmdistpct')::NUMERIC / 100)
        ) * (power_metrics->>'invertpowfac')::NUMERIC,
        2
    ) AS grid_quality
FROM 
    inverter;

SELECT 
    p.panemark AS panel_id,
    p.powratew::float AS power_ratings,
    perf.measpoww::float AS current_power,
    (
        perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct'
    )::float AS degradation,
    env.soillosspct::float AS soiling_loss,
    (inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::float AS inverter_losses,
    -- Calculate Total System Loss (TSL) per panel using Inverter Efficiency Loss (IEL)
    (
        (p.powratew::float * (1 - (
            perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct'
        )::float/100))
        * (1 - env.soillosspct::float/100)
        * (1 - (inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::float/100)
    ) AS total_system_loss
FROM 
    panel p
JOIN 
    performance perf ON p.panemark = perf.solmodref
JOIN 
    environment env ON p.hubregistry = env.arearegistry
JOIN 
    inverter inv ON p.hubregistry = inv.siteref
LIMIT 10;

WITH maintenance_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.growalias AS plant_name,
        p.gencapmw AS capacity_mw,
        m.maintcostusd AS total_maintenance_costs,
        m.revlossusd AS revenue_losses,
        (m.maintcostusd / m.revlossusd) AS maintenance_cost_efficiency_score,
        (m.revlossusd / p.gencapmw) AS revenue_loss_rate,
        (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw AS maintenance_cost_efficiency,
        (m.revlossusd / p.gencapmw) / ((m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw) AS mroi
    FROM 
        plant p
    JOIN 
        maintenance m ON p.growregistry = m.powerref
),
priority_levels AS (
    SELECT
        plant_name,
        capacity_mw,
        total_maintenance_costs,
        revenue_losses,
        maintenance_cost_efficiency_score,
        revenue_loss_rate,
        maintenance_cost_efficiency,
        mroi,
        CASE
            WHEN mroi > 1 THEN 'URGENT'
            WHEN mroi BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN mroi BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.5 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS priority_level
    FROM 
        maintenance_metrics
)
SELECT * FROM priority_levels;

WITH maintenance_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        p.growalias AS plant_name,
        p.gencapmw AS capacity_mw,
        m.maintcostusd AS total_maintenance_costs,
        m.revlossusd AS revenue_losses,
        (m.maintcostusd / p.gencapmw) AS maintenance_cost_efficiency_score,
        (m.revlossusd / p.gencapmw) AS revenue_loss_rate,
        (m.revlossusd / m.maintcostusd) AS mroi_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN (m.revlossusd / m.maintcostusd) < 0.5 THEN 'URGENT'
            WHEN (m.revlossusd / m.maintcostusd) BETWEEN 0.5 AND 0.7 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN (m.revlossusd / m.maintcostusd) BETWEEN 0.7 AND 0.9 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS final_priority_level
    FROM 
        plant p
    JOIN 
        maintenance m ON p.growregistry = m.powerref
)
SELECT 
    plant_name,
    capacity_mw,
    total_maintenance_costs,
    revenue_losses,
    maintenance_cost_efficiency_score,
    revenue_loss_rate,
    mroi_value,
    final_priority_level
FROM 
    maintenance_metrics;

WITH maintenance_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        p.growalias AS plant_name,
        p.gencapmw AS capacity_mw,
        SUM(m.maintcostusd) AS total_maintenance_cost,
        SUM(m.revlossusd) AS total_revenue_loss,
        (SUM(m.maintcostusd) / p.gencapmw) AS maintenance_cost_efficiency,
        (SUM(m.revlossusd) / p.gencapmw) AS revenue_loss_rate,
        ((SUM(m.revlossusd) / p.gencapmw) / (SUM(m.maintcostusd) / p.gencapmw)) AS mroi
    FROM 
        plant p
    JOIN 
        maintenance m ON p.growregistry = m.powerref
    GROUP BY 
        p.growalias, p.gencapmw
)
SELECT 
    plant_name,
    capacity_mw,
    total_maintenance_cost,
    total_revenue_loss,
    maintenance_cost_efficiency,
    revenue_loss_rate,
    mroi,
    CASE 
        WHEN mroi > 1.5 THEN 'URGENT'
        WHEN mroi BETWEEN 1 AND 1.5 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN mroi BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS priority_level
FROM 
    maintenance_metrics;

WITH maintenance_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.growalias AS plant_name,
        t1.gencapmw AS capacity_mw,
        SUM(t2.maintcostusd) AS total_maintenance_costs,
        SUM(t2.revlossusd) AS revenue_losses,
        (SUM(t2.maintcostusd) + SUM(t2.cleancostusd) + SUM(t2.replacecostusd)) / t1.gencapmw AS maintenance_cost_efficiency,
        SUM(t2.revlossusd) / SUM(t2.maintcostusd) AS revenue_loss_rate,
        (SUM(t2.revlossusd) / SUM(t2.maintcostusd)) / ((SUM(t2.maintcostusd) + SUM(t2.cleancostusd) + SUM(t2.replacecostusd)) / t1.gencapmw) AS mroi
    FROM 
        plant AS t1
    JOIN 
        maintenance AS t2 ON t1.growregistry = t2.powerref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.growalias, t1.gencapmw
),
priority_levels AS (
    SELECT 
        plant_name,
        capacity_mw,
        total_maintenance_costs,
        revenue_losses,
        maintenance_cost_efficiency,
        revenue_loss_rate,
        mroi,
        CASE 
            WHEN mroi > 1.5 THEN 'URGENT'
            WHEN mroi BETWEEN 1 AND 1.5 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN mroi BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS priority_level
    FROM 
        maintenance_metrics
)
SELECT 
    plant_name,
    capacity_mw,
    total_maintenance_costs,
    revenue_losses,
    maintenance_cost_efficiency,
    revenue_loss_rate,
    mroi,
    priority_level
FROM 
    priority_levels;

  SELECT 
    m.maintregistry, 
    (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw AS mce_score

WITH mce_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        maintregistry,
        (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw AS mce
    FROM maintenance m
    JOIN plant p ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
),
avg_mce AS (

)

FROM mce_cte
JOIN avg_mce
ON 1=1

WITH panel_age AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, initdate)) AS age,
        COUNT(*) AS panel_count
    FROM 
        plant
    GROUP BY 
        age
),
performance_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, pl.initdate)) AS age,
        AVG((efficiency_profile -> 'current_efficiency' ->> 'curreffpct')::NUMERIC) AS avg_efficiency
    FROM 
        performance AS pe
    JOIN 
        panel AS p ON pe.solmodref = p.panemark
    JOIN 
        plant AS pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
    GROUP BY 
        age
)
SELECT 
    pa.age AS panel_age,
    pm.avg_efficiency,
    pa.panel_count
FROM 
    panel_age AS pa
JOIN 
    performance_metrics AS pm ON pa.age = pm.age
ORDER BY 
    pa.age;

WITH panel_age AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, initdate)) AS age_years,
        COUNT(*) AS num_panels
    FROM 
        plant
    GROUP BY 
        age_years
),
average_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, pl.initdate)) AS age_years,
        AVG((efficiency_profile -> 'current_efficiency' ->> 'curreffpct')::NUMERIC) AS avg_efficiency
    FROM 
        performance AS pe
    JOIN 
        panel AS p ON pe.solmodref = p.panemark
    JOIN 
        plant AS pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
    GROUP BY 
        age_years
)
SELECT 
    pa.age_years AS panel_age,
    ae.avg_efficiency AS average_metric,
    pa.num_panels
FROM 
    panel_age AS pa
JOIN 
    average_efficiency AS ae ON pa.age_years = ae.age_years
ORDER BY 
    pa.age_years;

WITH panel_age AS (
    SELECT 
        panemark,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pl.initdate) AS age
    FROM 
        panel p
    JOIN 
        plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
),
age_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        panemark, 
        CASE 
            WHEN age < 5 THEN '0-5' 
            WHEN age >= 5 AND age < 10 THEN '5-10' 
            WHEN age >= 10 AND age < 15 THEN '10-15' 
            ELSE '15+' 
        END AS age_range, 
        age
    FROM 
        panel_age
),
performance_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        solmodref AS panemark, 
        JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'curreffpct')::NUMERIC AS curreffpct
    FROM 
        performance
),
panel_performance AS (
    SELECT 
        ar.panemark, 
        ar.age_range, 
        ar.age,
        pm.curreffpct
    FROM 
        age_ranges ar
    JOIN 
        performance_metrics pm ON ar.panemark = pm.panemark
)
SELECT 
    age_range, 
    AVG(curreffpct) AS avg_curreffpct, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT panemark) AS num_panels
FROM 
    panel_performance
GROUP BY 
    age_range
ORDER BY 
    age_range;

WITH plant_info AS (
    SELECT 
        growregistry AS plant_id,
        growalias AS plant_name,
        gencapmw AS gen_cap_mw,
        initdate AS installation_date
    FROM plant
),
maintenance_cost_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        powerref AS plant_id,
        (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd) / revlossusd AS maintenance_cost_efficiency
    FROM maintenance
),
downtime_loss_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        powerref AS plant_id,
        revlossusd / gen_cap_mw AS downtime_loss_rate
    FROM maintenance m
    JOIN plant_info p ON m.powerref = p.plant_id
),
return_score AS (
    SELECT 
        d.plant_id,
        downtime_loss_rate / maintenance_cost_efficiency AS return_score
    FROM downtime_loss_rate d
    JOIN maintenance_cost_efficiency m ON d.plant_id = m.plant_id
)
SELECT 
    pi.plant_name,
    maintenance_cost_efficiency,
    downtime_loss_rate,
    return_score
FROM plant_info pi
JOIN maintenance_cost_efficiency mce ON pi.plant_id = mce.plant_id
JOIN downtime_loss_rate dlr ON pi.plant_id = dlr.plant_id
JOIN return_score rs ON pi.plant_id = rs.plant_id;

WITH tsl_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        p.panemark AS panel_id,
        p.powratew AS power_rated_w,
        pe.measpoww AS measured_power_w,
        e.soillosspct AS soiling_loss_pct,
        CAST(i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct' AS NUMERIC) AS inverter_efficiency_pct,
        CAST(pe.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct' AS NUMERIC) AS cum_deg_pct
    FROM 
        panel p
    JOIN 
        performance pe ON p.panemark = pe.solmodref
    JOIN 
        environment e ON p.hubregistry = e.arearegistry
    JOIN 
        inverter i ON p.hubregistry = i.siteref
)
SELECT 
    panel_id,
    power_rated_w,
    measured_power_w,
    soiling_loss_pct,
    inverter_efficiency_pct,
    cum_deg_pct,
    (
        (power_rated_w * cum_deg_pct / 100) + 
        (measured_power_w * soiling_loss_pct / 100) + 
        (measured_power_w * (1 - inverter_efficiency_pct / 100))
    ) AS total_system_loss
FROM 
    tsl_cte;
